scope: execution validation of the path we would run: XLA, GPU, float32, 33 tokens, effective batch 2048, initialized from the real pretrained checkpoint
why_two_batches: the eager reference does not fit at the production batch -- `optimised|33|2048|train` without XLA OOMs on an 80 GB A100 -- so the graph comparison runs at the reference batch and V7 proves the scale-up changes nothing per row

keras_backend_selection.reason: no tf_keras shim: assuming TensorFlow bundles Keras 2, which the vendored PET needs. If tf.keras turns out to be Keras 3 the model will fail to build and that is the documented, loud failure.

limit_policy.how: each limit is FLOOR_SLACK x the eager path's own round-off floor, measured by permuting batch rows; no limit reads the quantity it judges, and every check has a mutant control

V0_pretrained_load.criterion: every variable covered and assigned EXACTLY; 0.0, not a tolerance

V1_forward_xla_vs_eager.limit_source: FLOOR_SLACK x the EAGER path's own floor; independent of the quantity being judged

V1_mutant_control.criterion: a real alteration must exceed the limit by 10.0x; if it does not, the limit is not discriminating and the check above proves nothing

V2_masking.criterion: EXACT equality for padded-slot CONTENT, PID and auxiliary channels. These are multiplied by a zero mask, so any difference at all is a leak rather than round-off

V2_coordinate_diagnostic.reads: moving a PADDED slot's coordinates reorders the k-NN among padded neighbours and changes the reduction order. Production zeroes padded slots, so this state does not occur; it is recorded so the round-off scale is visible rather than implied

V3_gradients_xla_vs_eager.limit_source: FLOOR_SLACK x the EAGER path's own floor; independent of the quantity being judged
V3_gradients_xla_vs_eager.note: the floor is the EAGER path's sensitivity to a row permutation. XLA fuses reductions differently from eager, so exceeding it is not by itself evidence of a wrong gradient -- read the mutant control beside this before concluding either way. The limit is NOT widened to accommodate the measurement

V3_mutant_control.criterion: a 1e-4 relative weight error must exceed the limit by 10.0x. Its ratio to the XLA deviation is the number that says whether XLA's disagreement is near a real defect or far below one

V7_batch_invariance.limit_source: FLOOR_SLACK x the EAGER path's own floor; independent of the quantity being judged
V7_batch_invariance.compares: XLA at the production batch against XLA at the reference batch, on the SAME rows, against the same floor

V4_optimizer_updates.criterion: every loss finite, the weights actually move, and the optimizer takes exactly the steps it was asked for

V5_reload.criterion: EXACT. The weights are zeroed between save and restore, so a restore that quietly did nothing would fail this
